name: Buffalo Shrimp Flatbread with Blue Cheese & Pickled Veggie Salad

ingredients.name: raw peeled shrimp, fresh or frozen

instructions.primary_message: Place vinegar and salt in a medium bowl; stir to combine the pickling liquid.
instructions.secondary_message:
½ cup rice vinegar
¾ tsp salt

instructions.primary_message: Wash and dry the fresh produce. (Skip the arugula if it came pre-washed.)
instructions.secondary_message:
3 medium carrots
3 sticks celery
1 ½ (5 oz) pkgs baby arugula

instructions.primary_message: Peel, trim, and halve carrots lengthwise, then cut crosswise into thin half-moons. Add to the bowl with the pickling liquid.
Trim and thinly slice celery crosswise. Add to the bowl, stir to combine, and set aside.

Divide flatbreads between two large baking sheet pans. Place in the oven (it doesn't have to be fully heated) and bake, flipping halfway through, until slightly crispy, about 10 minutes. Remove from oven.

Meanwhile, if using frozen shrimp, place them in a colander and run under cold water to thaw them slightly and remove any ice crystals. (If using fresh shrimp, skip this step.) Place the shrimp on a clean towel or paper towels and pat dry.
instructions.secondary_message: 2 ¼ lb raw peeled shrimp, fresh or frozen

instructions.primary_message: Preheat a large skillet over medium-high heat.
While the skillet heats up, place shrimp in a large bowl along with cornstarch, salt, and pepper. Toss to coat.
instructions.secondary_message:
2 tbsp cornstarch
¾ tsp salt
½ tsp black pepper

instructions.primary_message: Once the skillet is hot, add oil and swirl to coat the bottom. Add shrimp and cook, stirring occasionally, until just opaque, 3-4 minutes. Remove from heat, add hot sauce, and stir to combine.
instructions.secondary_message:
1 ½ tbsp extra virgin olive oil
⅓ cup hot sauce

instructions.primary_message: Meanwhile, place oil, salt, and pepper in a clean large bowl, then whisk to combine the dressing. Add pickled veggies and arugula, then toss to combine the salad.
instructions.secondary_message:
1 tbsp extra virgin olive oil
3 pinch salt
3 pinch black pepper

instructions.primary_message: Top each flatbread with a small handful of the arugula salad, spicy shrimp, and blue cheese. Slice into wedges. (Reserve remaining salad for serving.)
instructions.secondary_message: 1 ½ (4 oz) pkgs crumbled blue cheese

instructions.primary_message: Divide flatbreads between plates. Serve with remaining salad on the side and enjoy!
